title: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral - English Studies - Diphthongs
exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
subject: English Studies

questions.q: Identify the word that contains the diphthong `/ei/` as found in 'day'.
questions.explain: The word 'say' shares the `/ei/` diphthong with 'day'. 'Sky' has `/ai/`, 'boy' has `/ɔi/`, and 'cow' has `/au/`.
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q: Which word corresponds to the diphthong `/iə/`?
questions.explain: The word 'here' contains the `/iə/` diphthong. 'Care' and 'hair' have `/eə/`, and 'tour' has `/ʊə/`.
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q: Which of the following words contains the diphthong `/eə/`?
questions.explain: The word 'care' is pronounced with the `/eə/` diphthong. 'Clear' is `/iə/`, 'poor' can be `/ʊə/` or `/ɔ:/`, and 'pie' is `/ai/`.
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q: Identify the word that contains the diphthong `/au/` as heard in 'cow'.
questions.explain: The word 'loud' contains the `/au/` diphthong. 'Low' and 'show' use `/əʊ/`, and 'law' uses `/ɔ:/`.
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q: Which of these words contains the diphthong `/ɔi/` found in the word 'boy'?
questions.explain: The word 'boil' features the `/ɔi/` diphthong. 'Buy' uses `/ai/`, 'bow' can be `/au/` or `/əʊ/`, and 'ball' uses `/ɔ:/`.
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q: Which of the following words contains the diphthong `/ai/` like in the word 'my'?
questions.explain: The word 'sky' contains the `/ai/` sound. 'May' has `/ei/`, while 'me' and 'see' contain `/i:/`.
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q: Select the word that represents the `/ʊə/` sound as seen in 'tour'.
questions.explain: The word 'pure' commonly employs the `/ʊə/` diphthong (often preceded by /j/). 'Pour' is usually `/ɔ:/`, 'pear' is `/eə/`, and 'purr' is `/ɜ:/`.
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies
